result.summary: The image shows a commercial/mixed-use urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and traffic signals. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide roadway lacks modern safety features like curb extensions or high-visibility markings.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line near the intersection may block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right and left curbs approaching the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure, but lacks pedestrian-specific signals and refuge areas. The four-lane roadway width and lack of traffic calming measures create a significant crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide clear right-of-way timing for people crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve clarity and safety at the crossing.

result.summary: The environment features a standard urban intersection with sidewalks and curb ramps, but pedestrian infrastructure is basic. While a traffic signal and marked crosswalk are present, the markings are faded and there is a lack of dedicated pedestrian signal heads.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Potential for high vehicle speeds
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway design may encourage drivers to exceed safe urban speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the background

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure pedestrians are visible to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.
